desired_result: Decide what unattended production does after attempt 3's clean run, re-deciding Decision 0170 as it requires.
rationale: Decision 0170 kept unattended production at concurrency one for up to three attempts and handed the next decision to the operator after a clean run. Attempt 3 (2026-11-05) was clean: the worker merged #2124, #2125 and #2126 with independent review and QA passing first time. Rowan put this question to the operator in chat on 2026-11-05 as menu question 1, and the operator answered "1A" (recorded at https://github.com/pmark/arcadia/issues/1929#issuecomment-6673669313). This Ask records the question and its options as given, so the answer can be recorded on main. Production activation, spend and START remain gated by Decisions 0171 and 0173.

options.label: A. Continued serial runs
options.consequence: Unattended batches at concurrency one on queued Actions. Rowan presses each START card under a daily approval (Decision 0173), with a fresh pre-mortem before each. Production runs all night, and a batch that fails stops for the operator.

options.label: B. Serial runs, the operator presses each card
options.consequence: Safer, but progress stops whenever the operator is away.

options.label: C. No production until concurrency is built
